description: This PHP source file defines the MigrationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing database migrations during the installation or upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system. It handles GET requests to retrieve version ranges and POST requests to execute migrations.

classes.name: MigrationAPI
classes.description: A REST controller class that handles migration-related API requests during system upgrades.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve available migration versions based on the provided current version and inclusion options.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to execute a migration for a specific version or across a range of versions.
